note: D6 the forge offers BOTH siblings, half two: same seed, same board and the same three actions as d6_forge_variant_a, with `variant` 1 instead of 0. The shrine forges Piercing Lance, the kit becomes [solar_lance+pierce, mycelium_dash], and the identical cast deals 2 to the smokestack at (4,2) - which survives where Noon Lance killed it - and walks on to light the oil at (5,2) behind it, which no other card in the base pool can reach. Two records, one board, two kits: that is the fork the block is for. Make _act_upcycle_ability ignore the index (always variant 0) and this record fails in plain mode from its upcycle_ability id on; an out-of-range index is {t: illegal, action: upcycle_ability} and changes nothing, which the runner would also fail on
